import EntryLog.Spec
import EntryLog.Lemmas
namespace EntryLog
instance instDecidableValidEntry (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidEntry s e) := by
  unfold ValidEntry; infer_instance
def step : Impl := fun s e =>
  match h : receiptOf s.log e.id with
  | some n => (.ok n, s)
  | none =>
    if ValidEntry s e then
      (.ok s.log.length,
       { s with log := s.log ++ [e],
                balance := fun a => s.balance a + (if a = e.account then e.amount else 0) })
    else (.rejected, s)
theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop   : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_duplicate      : DuplicateReturnsOriginal step := sorry
theorem req_effects        : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_append_only    : AppendOnly step := sorry
theorem req_unique_ids     : UniqueIds step := sorry
theorem req_nonnegative    : NonNegative step := sorry
theorem req_consistent     : StaysConsistent step := sorry
end EntryLog

theorem req_nonnegative_helper : NonNegative step := by
  intro s e hpos a ha
  by_cases hdup : ∃ n, receiptOf s.log e.id = some n
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hdup
    have hstep : step s e = (.ok n, s) := by unfold step; rw [hn]
    rw [hstep] at ha ⊢
    simp only at ha ⊢
    exact hpos a ha
  · have hnone : receiptOf s.log e.id = none := by
      cases h : receiptOf s.log e.id with
      | some n => exact absurd ⟨n, h⟩ hdup
      | none => rfl
    have hstep_eq : step s e =
      (if ValidEntry s e then
        (.ok s.log.length,
          { s with log := s.log ++ [e],
                   balance := fun a => s.balance a + (if a = e.account then e.amount else 0) })
       else (.rejected, s)) := by unfold step; rw [hnone]
    by_cases hvalid : ValidEntry s e
    · rw [hstep_eq, if_pos hvalid] at ha ⊢
      simp only at ha ⊢
      simp only at ⊢
      rcases hvalid with ⟨hmem, hne, hle⟩
      by_cases heq : a = e.account
